response.text:
I can’t continue working in the background or message you later unless a real automation/reminder is created through an available tool and confirmed. I won’t be able to “take a few hours on this and message you when finished” on my own.

How would you like to proceed? Options:
1. Tell me exactly what “this” is and I’ll do as much as I can right now in this session (and tell you how long it will take).  
2. If you want an actual later notification, I can help create a calendar reminder or scheduled email — tell me which calendar/email account/tool to use and the exact details and I’ll prepare it (you’ll need to confirm sending/creation).  
3. I can give a step-by-step plan and checklist you (or someone else) can run over the next few hours, and report back when done.

Which option do you want, and what specifically should I work on?
